content: The most damaging common mistake is leaving a plaintext CSV/JSON export on disk after using it for migration/backup -- these files land in Downloads, cloud-sync folders, search indexes, and backups, and are more valuable to an attacker than the device itself. Prefer an encrypted export format (re-encrypted with master password or a separate export passphrase) over plaintext CSV, and if plaintext export is unavoidable, explicitly instruct users to securely delete it (including from Trash/cloud sync) immediately after use.
